comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body: The easiest way to get these is to run the Giza middle floors. Fine velvet is a reward from floor 8. If you do not want to do that, then Savaii has a recipe to make these as well. I do not know about the other private farms.

comments.body: Any of the four private farms can make these (and any other private farm recipe for that matter). It just requires the proper development. And of course you have to physically visit your private farm to make them.
